Criteria, each scored 1 to 5, higher is better. Evidence for all three is the maker's own published pages and manuals.

- noise at the boil: how loud is the kettle at the boil, as measured by a named test? 1 = a measured level above 70 dB(A); 3 = 55 to 70 dB(A); 5 = below 55 dB(A). Heads-up: makers rarely publish a measured noise level, so this one may come back mostly as qualified blanks. That is my inference, not something I have checked. A blank you were warned about is a finding, so you can keep it knowing that, reshape it, or drop it.
